how_it_works.nad_intro: **Tor Anomaliya Anyklamasy (NAD)** - bu tor trafikindaki adaty bazadan gyşayan adatdan daşary nusgalary tapmak prosesi. Bu gyşamalar koplenç howpsuzlyk howplaryny, mysal ucin giris basyp almagy, maglumat cykarmagy ya-da hyzmatdan mahrum etme hujumlaryny gorkezýär.
how_it_works.nad_why_volume: **Mukdar**: Hazirki torlar her sagat milyonlarca akym doredýär -- el bilen barlamaga juda kop.
how_it_works.nad_why_speed: **Tizlik**: Hujumlar saniyalarda gujeyip biler. Awtomatik anyklama hakykat wagt jogabyny mumkin edirýär.
how_it_works.nad_why_sophistication: **Ceperlik**: Hujumcylar taktikasyny hemişe uytgedýär. ML-esasly anyklama düzgün-esasly ulgamlaryň goyberyan ozal gorylmedik (zero-day) nusgalaryny tapyp biler.
how_it_works.nad_system_note: Bu ulgam **IDS** -- anomaliyany anyklayar we hasabat berýär. Onlemek (bloklamak) firewall ya-da tor gateway integrasiyasyny talap edýär.
how_it_works.nad_signature_desc: **Imza-esasly**: Trafiki belli hujum nusgalary bilen deneshdirýär (antivirus düzgünleri yaly). Belli howplar ucin tiz we takyk, yöne täze hujumlara kor.
how_it_works.nad_anomaly_desc: **Anomaliya-esasly**: "adaty" trafik neme digini owrengin we gyşan zatlary bellengin. Zero-day hujumlaryny tapyp biler, yone yalnys oňyn berip biler. **Bu ulgam mashyn okuwy bilen goldalan anomaliya-esasly anyklamany ulanýar.**
how_it_works.cicids_intro: **Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity Intrusion Detection System 2017** (CICIDS2017) dataseti New Brunswick uniwesiteti tarapyndan doredildi. Ol tor giris anyklama tadkikatynda iñ kop ulanylyan benchmark datasetlerinden biridir.
how_it_works.cicids_features: **Alamatlar**: CICFlowMeter bilen cykarylan 80+ tor akym alamaty
how_it_works.cicids_protocols: **Protokollar**: HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SSH we email protokollary
how_it_works.cicids_classes_intro: Onislem we klas balansyndan son modelimiz akymlary **7 klassa** bolýär:
how_it_works.cicids_class_dos_hulk: **DoS Hulk** -- Hulk guraly bilen DoS hujumi
how_it_works.ml_lightgbm_desc: **LightGBM** (Light Gradient Boosting Machine) - esasy klassifikatorymyz bolup, CICIDS2017 test toplumynda **98.2% takyklyk** gazanýar.
how_it_works.ml_lightgbm_how_1: **Leaf-wise agaç osmesini** ulanýar (XGBoost-daky level-wise yerine), bu kop wagty tiz konvergensiya we yokary takyklyk berýär.
how_it_works.ml_lightgbm_how_2: Uznuksiz alamatlary netijeli islemezlik ucin **histogram esasly bolunmeni** ulanýar.
how_it_works.ml_lightgbm_why_1: Has tiz okadysh we inference (<15ms her batch)
how_it_works.ml_lightgbm_why_2: Az yady sarp edyar -- hakykat wagt dashboardlary ucin amatly
how_it_works.ml_lightgbm_params_2: StandardScaler normalizasiyasyndan son 78 sanly alamat bilen okadyldy
how_it_works.ml_rf_desc: **Random Forest** - maglumatyn tötanleýin bolumlerinde okadylan karar agaclary ansamblydyr.
how_it_works.ml_rf_how_2: Her agaç okadylysh maglumatyn tötanleýin nusgasyny (bootstrap) gorýär
how_it_works.ml_rf_how_3: Ahyrky caklama ähli agaclar boyuncha **kopluk ses berişi** arkaly edilýär
how_it_works.ml_rf_pros: **Artykmaçlyklary:** Overfittinge durnukly, feature importance dusunukli, scaling gerek dal.
how_it_works.ml_rf_cons: **Kemcilikleri:** LightGBM-den has haýal inference, bu datasetde takyklygy pesrak.
how_it_works.ml_xgb_desc: **XGBoost** (Extreme Gradient Boosting) - regularizasiya edilen gradient boosting frameworkidir.
how_it_works.ml_xgb_how_1: Agaçlary **yzygiderli** gurýar, her yeni agaç ozalky yalnyslyklary duzedýär
how_it_works.ml_xgb_how_2: Overfittingin onuni almak ucin **L1 we L2 regularizasiya** ulanýar
how_it_works.ml_xgb_pros: **Artykmaçlyklary:** Gucly regularizasiya, missing value goldawy, GPU goldawy.
how_it_works.ml_xgb_cons: **Kemcilikleri:** Level-wise osme LightGBM-in leaf-wise çemelesinden az netijeli bolup biler.
how_it_works.ml_lstm_desc: **LSTM Autoencoder** - anomaliya anyklamak ucin unsupervised deep learning modelidir.
how_it_works.ml_lstm_how_1: **Encoder**: LSTM gatlaklary 78-olcemli girişi 32-olcemli latent meyda gysýar
how_it_works.ml_lstm_how_2: **Decoder**: LSTM gatlaklary gysylan gornusden asyl girişi gaytadan dikeldýär
how_it_works.ml_lstm_how_3: "Adaty" nusgalary owrensin diye **diňe howpsuz trafikde** okadylýar
how_it_works.ml_lstm_how_4: Inference wagtynda yokary **rekonstruksiya yalnyslygy** anomaliyany gorkezýär
how_it_works.ml_lstm_cons: **Kemcilikleri:** Yalnys oňyn derejesi yokary, cek sazlamasyny seresap duzmegi talap edýär.
how_it_works.fe_what_desc: **Tor akymy** bir protokoly ulanýan iki endpoint arasynda (IP:port juti) paketler yzygideridir. Aýratyn paketleri seljermegiň yerine, biz olary akymlara birlesdirip statistiki alamatlary cykaryarys:
how_it_works.fe_packet_counts: **Paket sany**: Gidiş paketleri, gelis paketleri, jemi paket
how_it_works.fe_byte_counts: **Byte sany**: Gidiş byte, gelis byte, jemi byte
how_it_works.fe_timing: **Wagt**: Akym dowamlylygy, paket arasy wagtlar (IAT), işjeň/bos wagtlar
how_it_works.fe_tcp_flags: **TCP flaglary**: SYN, ACK, FIN, RST, PSH sany
how_it_works.fe_statistical: **Statistiki**: Paket olcemleri we IAT-lerin orta, std, min, max gymmatlary
how_it_works.fe_scaler_desc: Alamatlary ML modele bermezden on **StandardScaler** ulanarys:
how_it_works.fe_scaler_explain: Bu hemme alamatlaryn orta qiymetini 0 we dispersiýasyny 1 edýär, boyuk magnitudaly alamatlaryň (mysal, bytes/s) kici magnitudaly alamatlary (mysal, flag sany) basyp yitirmeginiň onuni alýar.
how_it_works.fe_smote_desc: CICIDS2017 dataseti gaty disbalansly (>80% howpsuz trafik). Klasslary balanslamak ucin **SMOTE** (Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique) ulanarys:
how_it_works.fe_smote_1: SMOTE azlyk klasslary ucin **sintetiki** nusga doredýär
how_it_works.fe_smote_2: Ol bar bolan azlyk nusgalary we olaryn iñ yakyn goňşularyny interpolasiya edip isleýär
how_it_works.fe_smote_3: Bu modelin hemme zady "BENIGN" diye caklamagynyn onuni alýar
how_it_works.arch_threshold_desc: Model her caklama ucin **ynam bahasyny** (0.0 - 1.0) cykaryar.
how_it_works.arch_threshold_rule: **Ynam ceginden** pes bolan akymlar (Sazlamalarda uytgedilip bolyar) howpsuz hasaplanylýar
how_it_works.attack_ddos_desc:
DDoS hujumi maksat serweri kop cesmeden gelen uly trafik bilen basyp, kanuny ulanyjylara elyeterli bolmagyny togtadýar. CICIDS2017-de LOIT guraly ulanyldy.

**Nadip isleýär:** Spoof edilen cesme IP-lerden her sekunda munden-munde SYN paketleri maksat tarapa akdyrylýar we birikdirme tablisasynyn resurslaryny tuysetýär.

**Modelin ulanýan esasy alamatlary:** gaty yokary `Flow Packets/s`, yokary `Flow Bytes/s`, kop `SYN` flagy, juda gysga `Flow Duration`, pes `Bwd Packets` (kopunç bir taraply).

**Garsy cala:** Rate limiting, SYN cookies, trafik scrubbing hyzmatlary, blackhole routing.
how_it_works.attack_dos_hulk_desc:
DoS Hulk keshlemegi aylanyp gecmek we web serweri basmak ucin ozbolusly, gizlenen HTTP GET soraglaryny doredýär. Yonekey flooddan tapawutlylykda her sorag basga gorunýär.

**Nadip isleýär:** Keshlanmezlik ucin random URL parametrli tiz HTTP soraglary iberilýär. Her sorag serweri doly jogap islemage mejbur edýär.

**Esasy alamatlar:** yokary `Fwd Packet Length`, orta `Flow Duration`, yzygiderli `Fwd Packets` sany, yokary `Flow Bytes/s`.

**Garsy cala:** Web Application Firewall (WAF), her IP ucin sorag tizligini caklemek, CAPTCHA synaglary.
how_it_works.attack_portscan_desc:
Port scanning - maksat hostdaky acyk hyzmatlary tapmak ucin recon tehnikasydyr. Hujumcylar ejiz hyzmatlary tapmak ucin kop porty barlayar.

**Nadip isleýär:** Yzygiderli ya-da random portlara SYN paketleri iberýär. Acyk port SYN-ACK bilen jogap berýär; yapyk port RST bilen jogap berýär.

**Esasy alamatlar:** kop yeke-tak `Dst Ports`, juda kici `Fwd Packet Length` (diňe SYN paketleri), gysga `Flow Duration`, yokary `Flow Packets/s`, az `Bwd Packets`.

**Garsy cala:** Portlaryn acyklygyny caklayar firewall düzgünleri, IDS duysdurysy, port knocking.
how_it_works.attack_ftp_desc:
FTP-Patator Patator guralyny ulanyp FTP serwerlerine (port 21) brut-force login synanyşlaryny edýär, kop ulanyjy/parol kombinasiyalaryny synaýar.

**Nadip isleýär:** Port 21-e dürli maglumatlar bilen gaýtalanýan TCP birikmeleri açylýar. Her synanyşyk autentifikasiya maglumatly gysga akym doredýär.

**Esasy alamatlar:** `Dst Port` = 21, orta `Fwd Bytes` (auth maglumatlary), bir cesmeden kop gysga akym, yzygiderli `Flow Duration`.

**Garsy cala:** Hasap blokirovka syyasaty, fail2ban, gujli parollar, anonim FTP-ni oçurmek.
how_it_works.attack_ssh_desc:
SSH-Patator Patator guraly bilen port 22-de SSH login maglumatlaryny brut-force edip synaýar. FTP-Patator yaly, yone SSH protokoly nyşana alyar.

**Nadip isleýär:** Dürli maglumatlar bilen gaýtalanýan SSH birikdirme synanyşlary edilýär. SSH handshake ozune mahsus akym nusgasyny doredýär.

**Esasy alamatlar:** `Dst Port` = 22, FTP-den has yokary `Fwd Bytes` (SSH handshake ulyrak), bir source IP-den kop akym, yzygiderli wagt nusgalary.

**Garsy cala:** Diňe acarly autentifikasiya, fail2ban, standart dal SSH port, MFA.
how_it_works.attack_bot_desc:
Botnet trafiki yokan hostlar bilen Command-and-Control (C2) serwerin arasyndaky aragatnasygy bildirýär. CICIDS2017-de ARES botneti ulanyldy.

**Nadip isleýär:** Yokan hostlar C2 serwerine periodik baglanyp komanda alýar we maglumat cykaryar. Trafik nusgalary yzygiderli we dowamly bolýar.

**Esasy alamatlar:** yzygiderli `Flow Duration`, durnukly `IAT` (inter-arrival times), orta `Bytes/s`, iki taraply aragatnasyk (hem `Fwd`, hem `Bwd` paketler bar).

**Garsy cala:** Tor segmentasiyasy, DNS sinkholing, endpoint detection and response (EDR).

glossary.network_flow: Bir protokoly ulanýan iki endpoint arasynda paketler yzygideri (src_ip:src_port ↔ dst_ip:dst_port).
glossary.pcap: Packet Capture -- tutulan tor paketlerini saklamak ucin fayl formaty. Wireshark we tcpdump yaly gurallar doredýär.
glossary.ids_ips: Intrusion Detection System (barlayar we duysdurar) / Intrusion Prevention System (barlayar we bloklayar).
glossary.cicids2017: Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity Intrusion Detection System 2017 -- modellerimizi okatmakda ulanylan benchmark dataset.
glossary.gradient_boosting: Her yeni model ozalky yalnyslyklary duzedyan yzygider ansambl ML tehnikasy.
glossary.lightgbm: Light Gradient Boosting Machine -- Microsoft tarapyndan doredilen tiz, leaf-wise gradient boosting frameworki.
glossary.random_forest: Tötanleýin maglumat bolumlerinde okadylan karar agaclary ansambly; caklama kopluk ses bilen edilýär.
glossary.xgboost: Extreme Gradient Boosting -- L1/L2 jerime bilen regularizasiya edilen gradient boosting frameworki.
glossary.autoencoder: Giris maglumatyny gysyp gaytadan dikeldyan neyron tor. Yokary rekonstruksiya yalnyslygy anomaliyany bildirýär.
glossary.lstm: Long Short-Term Memory -- yzygider maglumatda uzak baglylyklary owrip bilyan recurrent neyron tor gornusi.
glossary.smote: Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique -- az synply toparlary balanslamak ucin sintetiki nusga doredýär.
glossary.standard_scaler: Alamatlary orta 0 we dispersiya 1 edip normalizleyar: X_scaled = (X - mean) / std.
glossary.feature_importance: Her alamatyn model caklamasyna nace pay goşandygyny gorkezýan skor.
glossary.f1_score: Precision bilen Recall-yň garmonik ortasy. Yalnys oňyn we yalnys tersleri balanslayar.
glossary.precision: Oňyn diyip caklanan mysallaryn nacesi hakykatdan oňyn? TP / (TP + FP).
glossary.recall: Hakykat oňyn mysallaryn naceisini model tapdy? TP / (TP + FN). Sensitivity hem diyilýar.
glossary.false_positive: Howpsuz akymyn yalnyslyk bilen hujum diye klassifikasiya edilmegi. Gereksiz duysdurys doredýär.
glossary.false_negative: Hujum akymynyn yalnyslyk bilen howpsuz diye klassifikasiya edilmegi. Iñ howply yalnyslyk gornusi.
glossary.confidence_score: Modelin caklan klassyna beren ehtimallygy. Aralyk: 0.0 (ynamsuz) - 1.0 (ynamly).
glossary.confidence_threshold: Akymy hujum diye belgilemek ucin gerek minimum ynam. Sazlamalarda uytgedilip bilner.
glossary.severity_level: Ynama gore bellenýär: Orta (<90%), Yokary (90-95%), Kritiki (>95%).
glossary.tcp_flags: TCP header kontrol bitleri: SYN (baglanyşyk basy), ACK (tassyklama), FIN (gutarmak), RST (reset), PSH (maglumat itermek).
glossary.iat: Inter-Arrival Time -- akymdaky yzygider paketlerin arasyndaky wagt. Awtomat hujumlaryny tapmakda mohum alamat.
glossary.scapy: Paket manipulasiya, captura we craft ucin Python kitaphanasy. Canly captura we hujum iberiji skriptde ulanylýar.
glossary.ddos: Distributed Denial of Service -- kop cesmeden trafik iberip maksady elyetersiz etmek.
glossary.brute_force: Dogrysy tapylýança kop parol kombinasiyasyny synayan hujum. SSH (22) ya-da FTP (21) nyşana alyar.
glossary.port_scan: Maksatdaky işleýän hyzmatlary tapmak ucin kop porty barlayan recon tehnikasy.
glossary.botnet: Hujumcy tarapyndan Command-and-Control (C2) arkaly dolandyrylyan kompromat hostlar tory.
glossary.c2: Botnetde kompromat mashynlara komanda iberyan serwer.
